spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अंबति)
To move, to go.

f. (-म्बा)
1 A mother.
2 The same, (in theatrical language.)
3 A name of DURGĀ. See अम्बिका.
E.
अबि to sound, अप् and टाप् affs.

n. (-कं)
1 The eye.
2 Copper.
E.
अम्ब to go, and वुन् aff.

n. (-रं)
1 The sky or atmosphere.
2 Clothes, apparel.
3 A perfume, (Ambergris.)
4

Cotton.
5

Talc.
E.
अम्ब to go, and अरन् aff.

n. (-गं)
The two principal female garments, or upper and lower cloths or mantles.
E.
अम्वर, and युगं a pair.

m. (-न्तः)
1 The horizon.
2 The end of a garment.
E.
अम्बर, and अन्त end.

mn. (-षः-षं)
A frying pan. See the next.

mn. (-षः-षं)
1 A frying pan.
2 War, battle.
m. (-षः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2
Also of VIṢṆ

A young animal, a colt, a boy.
4 The name of a king of the solar race, celebrated as a worshipper of VIṢṆ

A division of hell.
6 The sun.
7

Repentance.
8

A tree, (Spondias mangifera.)
E.
अबि to sound, and ईषन् Uṇādi affix, but irregularly formed.

m. (-ष्ठः)
1 The name of a country, stated to be in the eastern division of India, and supposed by Mr. WILFORD, to be the abode of the AMBASTOE of

Arrian.
2

The offspring of a man of the Brahman, and a woman of the Vaiśya tribe, a man of the medical cast.
f. (-ष्ठा)
1 A sort of jasmin, (Jasminum auriculatum.)
2 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) See बनतिक्तिका.
3 Woodsorrel, (Oxalis corniculata, Rox.)
E.
अम्बा a mother, स्था to stand, and क affix, what cherishes-like a mother.

f. (-की)
A creeper, (Cissampelos hexandra.) Also अम्बष्ठा and अम्बष्ठिका.

f. (-का)
1 A mother.
2 The mother of PĀṆḌU.

f. (का)
1 A mother.
2 A name of PĀRVATĪ.
3 The mother of DHṚTARĀṢṬ

RA.
4
One of the female domestic deities of the

Jainas.
5

A medicinal plant. See कटुकी.
E.
अम्बा a mother, and कन् affix; like a mother.

m. (-यः)
1 GAṆEŚA, or KĀRTTIKEYA, both sons of PĀRVATĪ.
2 A name of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA.
E.
अम्बिका as above; and ढक affix, implying family decent.

m. (-यः)
1 A name of DHṚTARĀṢṬ

RA.
2

Also of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
अम्बिका the mother of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA or a name of DURGĀ, and ढक् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 GAṆ

EŚA.
3

DHṚTARĀṢṬRA.
E.
as the preceding, कन् being added.

n. (-म्बु)
Water.
E.
अबि to sound, and उ aff.

f. (-णा)
A drop of water.
E.
अम्बु, and कण a particle.

m. (-कः)
The short-nosed alligator.
E.
अम्बु water, and कण्ठक a thorn.

m. (-तः)
An alligator.
E.
अम्बु, and किरात a savage.

m. (-शः)
A porpoise, especially of the kind common in the Ganges, (Delphinus gangeticus, Rox.)
E.
अम्बु, and कीश, the water-monkey.

m. (-र्म्मः)
A porpoise, especially the gangetic.
E.
अम्बु, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Aquatical.
E.
अम्बु, and चर what moves in.

n. (-रं)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) See शैवाल.
E.
अम्बु, and चामर the Indian chowrie; the water-chowrie.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Aquatical, as a fish, &c.
E.
अम्बु, चर to go, णिनि aff.

m. (-जः)
A plant, (Eugenia acutangula.) See हिज्जल.
n. (-जं)
1 A lotus, (Nymphaea nelumbo.)
2 The thunderbolt of INDRA.
mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Aquatic, water-born.
E.
अम्बु, and ज what is produced; water-born.

n. (-न्म)
A lotus.
E.
अम्बु, and जन्म birth.

m. (-लः)
Vallisneria. See अम्बुचामर.

m. (-दः)
A cloud.
mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Shedding or giving water.
E.
अम्बु, and द what gives.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
अम्बु, and धि what possesses; from धाञ् with कि affixed.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
अम्बु, and निधि a treasure.

m. (-पः)
A plant, (Cassia tora, or alata.)
mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Drinking or imbibing water.
E.
अम्बु, and प what drinks.

f. (-त्रा)
A fragrant grass, (perhaps a Cyperus.) See उच्चटा.
E.
अम्बु, and पत्र a leaf.

f. (-तिः)
Current, stream, flow of water.
E.
अम्बु, and पद्धति distinction.

m. (-नः)
The clearing nut tree, (Strychnos potatorum.)
E.
अम्बु water, प्रसद to cleanse, घञ affix. The nuts of this plant are generally used in India, for purifying water: they are rubbed upon the inner surface of the vessel, and occasion the precipitation of the impurities of the fluid.

m. (-भृत्)
1 A cloud.
2 The ocean.
3 A grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)
E.
अम्बु, and भृत् what nourishes, from भृञ् with क्विप् aff.

m. (-मान्)
The side of a river, or a bank, a shore.
mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Watery, having or containing water.
E.
अम्ब and मतुप् aff.

m. (-जः)
A bivalve shell.
E.
अम्बु water, मात्र all, every kind, and ज produced.

m. (-मुक्)
A cloud.
E.
अम्बु, and मुच् what lets go.

m. (-रः)
The lower limb of a door frame, the threshold.
E.
अम्बु, and राज to shine, affix ड.

m. (-शिः)
The ocean.
E.
अम्बु, and राशि a heap.

m. (-रुहः)
1 Any aquatic plant.
2 A lotus.
E.
अम्बु, and रुह् what grows on or in.

f. (-णी)
A lotus.
E.
अम्बु, and रोहिन् what grows, or rises on or in.

f. (-ची)
Four days in Āṣārha, the 10th to the 13th of the dark fortnight, when the earth is supposed to be unclean, and agriculture is prohibited.
E.
अम्बु, and वाच् speech, with ङीष added.

f. (-सी)
See the preceding.

f. (-नी)
Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
E.
अम्बु before वस to abide, णिनि and ङीप् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 A cloud.
2 The cyperus.
3 A water carrier.
E.
अम्बु water, and वाह what bears.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Carrying or conveying water.
f. (-नी)
A wooden baling vessel.
E.
अम्बु, and वाहिन् what bears.

m. (-सः)
A kind of cane or reed growing in water. See वेतस.

f. (-णी)
A leech.
E.
अम्बु before सृप् to go, णिनि affix; and डीष् fem. do.

f. (-नी)
A vessel used for baling water out of a boat.
E.
अम्बु, षिच् to sprinkle, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sputtered, (speech, discourse.)
E.
अम्बु water, and कृत made.

m. (-म्ब्लः)
Sourness.
E.
अम्ब to go, and क्ल Uṇādi aff.
